name: @puyinkai/xiaobao-cli
description: 旺小宝 CLI — host-agnostic 业务数据 / 问数 / 来访总结 / 知识库 能力 (openclaw-xiaobao plugin 的 CLI 等价物)

scripts.workbuddy:pack: rm -rf dist-workbuddy && mkdir -p dist-workbuddy/wangxiaobao && cp workbuddy/connector-meta.json workbuddy/cli.json workbuddy/icon.svg dist-workbuddy/wangxiaobao/ && cp -R skills dist-workbuddy/wangxiaobao/skills && cd dist-workbuddy && zip -qr wangxiaobao-connector.zip wangxiaobao && echo dist-workbuddy/wangxiaobao-connector.zip
